content_zh:
温爸爸只来得及和她说一声，暖暖，小心方柳城。
温暖哭喊着看着警车把爸爸压走，温家外，一群人站着，指指点点，温暖浑身力量都似被抽走了，爸爸被压走，临走前扔下一句，小心方柳城，那是什么意思？
为什么爸爸会被押走，她全然不知，猛然想起妈妈和妹妹，温暖咬牙擦干眼泪，跑进家里。
家里乱成一团，两位叔叔，几位堂姐，堂哥，她的舅舅，还有表姐等人都在大厅里，温妈妈坐在沙发上落泪，温静在一旁红着眼睛宽慰着她。
“妈妈，小静……”
正在哭的温妈妈突然抬起头，温暖只见她的眼睛一片血红，表情瞬间狰狞起来，她敏捷地从沙发上跳起来，一巴掌朝温暖打过来，温暖白皙的脸颊上浮起手印，疼痛让她摇摇欲坠。
“妈，你在做什么？又不关姐姐的事情。”温静飞快起来，拉住还想继续打温暖的温妈妈，温暖脑海更是空白。
叔叔，堂姐和舅舅，表姐们的表情都如仇人般看着她，那眼光看的温暖如芒刺背，心凉透顶，他们都在指责她，都在怨恨地看她。
她做什么？她不明白。
“你也太贱了，竟然会和方柳城一起害叔叔坐牢，你安什么心？”大堂姐温秀丽说道。
“哼，昨晚还一夜不归，你和方柳城鬼混去了吧，你对得起叔叔吗？”二堂姐温美丽说说道。
“嫂子，这样的女儿你还不赶出家门，要不是她喜欢方柳城，把大哥的资料都偷给方柳城，温家至于败了吗？”二叔愤怒叫嚣。
温暖笑了，笑得灿烂，那笑容从脸上延伸到目光中，笑得令众人害怕。温暖是那种悲哀到极点，却仍旧能笑得灿烂的女子。
那笑容，仿佛从不曾在她脸上消失过。
温静一把搂住她，“姐姐，不关你事，别听他们胡说。”
温静扭头，劈手指着大门，“滚，你们从这里滚出我家！”
温家在A市小有名气，虽不算是上流社会，却也富足有余，温爸爸白手起家，从小小的包工头到建筑公司的董事长，温家建筑有限公司在业界也算小有名气。
方柳城架空公司，举报温爸爸贿赂、涉嫌商业犯罪，已被警方扣押调查，几个月沿海城市家族型走私犯罪案件牵连甚广，官场，企业不少人相继落网，温爸爸更不信涉嫌这一宗大型经济案件中。
温爸爸一被抓，被方柳城架空的温家企业土崩瓦解，他成功的接收了温家，且让温家负债累累，高达上千万，温家的别墅过几天就会被封，拍卖，温家名下所有的财产都将被没收。
温暖无形中成了帮凶，这么多年，一心只顾着喜欢方柳城，却从不去想，为什么他总是向她打听爸爸的去处，爸爸谈事的细节……

方柳城走进温家，负手而立，他一身白色西装衬出他健美的身材，英俊的五官线条硬朗，给人几分冷酷逼人的感觉。人往门口一站，便有几分发号施令的气势。温暖心冷，原来这些年的温柔和善都是装出来的。温妈妈似疯了般，冲上去就要打他，被他身边的保镖推到一旁，温暖和温静上去扶她。
温妈妈指着他的鼻子骂他忘恩负义，恩将仇报，方柳城讥诮一笑，温暖一直低着头，突然抬头，问：“方柳城，为什么？”
方柳城因她的称呼一怔，复而勾起冷酷的笑，“为什么，我也要让你们温家尝一尝家破人亡的滋味。”
十余年前，方家还是一间小小的建筑公司，温爸爸收购方家，逼的方家夫妇牵手坠楼而亡，留下年幼的方柳城流落孤儿院。温爸爸四处巡查，得知方家有遗孤，一时心有不忍，领养了方柳城，他几乎和温暖一起长大，最后进入温爸爸的公司，最终整垮温家。
而此时，温暖才知道，方柳城早就功成名就，拥有自己的事业王国，潜在温家，不过是为了击垮她们。
很好，很完美的计划。
“暖暖，真谢谢你。”方柳城的声音有些许恶毒，更有一种报复的快感。
温暖挺直背脊，露出甜美的微笑，咬牙，一字一顿道：“方柳城，风水轮流转，你也有阴沟翻船的那天，我等着。”
他似乎从她身上看到一种夺目的光彩。

content_en:
Father Wen only had time to tell her, Nuannuan, be careful of Fang Liucheng.
Wen Nuan cried and watched as the police car drove his father away. Outside Wen's house, a group of people stood and pointed. All the strength in Wen Nuan's body seemed to have been taken away. His father was pressed away. Before leaving, he dropped a sentence, be careful of Fang Liucheng. What does that mean?
She had no idea why her father was taken away. She suddenly thought of her mother and sister, gritted her teeth, wiped away her tears, and ran into the house.
The house was in a mess. Two uncles, several cousins, her cousin, her uncle, and cousin were all in the hall. Wen's mother sat on the sofa and cried, while Wen Jing comforted her with red eyes.
"Mom, Xiaojing..."
Wen's mother, who was crying, suddenly raised her head. Wen Wen saw her eyes were blood red, and her expression instantly became ferocious. She jumped up from the sofa quickly and slapped Wen Wen. Handprints appeared on Wen Wen's white cheeks, and the pain made her stagger.
"Mom, what are you doing? It's none of my sister's business." Wen Jing stood up quickly and grabbed Wen's mother who wanted to continue hitting Wen Nuan, but Nuan Nuan's mind went blank.
Her uncles, cousins, uncles, and cousins ​​all looked at her like enemies. Their eyes were as warm as thorns on their backs, and their hearts were cold. They were all blaming her and looking at her with resentment.
What does she do? She doesn't understand.
"You are too mean. You would put your uncle in jail together with Fang Liucheng. Why do you feel at ease?" said the eldest cousin Wen Xiuli.
"Humph, you didn't come back all night last night. You went to fool around with Fang Liucheng. Are you worthy of uncle?" Second cousin Wen Meili said.
"Sister-in-law, why don't you drive such a daughter out of the house? If she hadn't liked Fang Liucheng and stole all the information about her eldest brother to Fang Liucheng, would the Wen family have been defeated?" the second uncle shouted angrily.
Wen Nuan smiled, a bright smile that extended from his face to his eyes, a smile that scared everyone. Wen Nuan is the kind of woman who is extremely sad but can still smile brightly.
That smile seemed to have never disappeared from her face.
Wen Jing hugged her and said, "Sister, it's none of your business. Don't listen to their nonsense."
Wen Jing turned her head and pointed at the door, "Get out of here, get out of my house from here!"
The Wen family is well-known in City A. Although it is not considered to be the upper class, it is still wealthy. Father Wen started from scratch, from a small contractor to the chairman of the construction company. The Wen Family Construction Co., Ltd. is also relatively well-known in the industry.
Fang Liucheng, a fake company, reported Wen's father for bribery and suspected commercial crimes, and was detained by the police for investigation. In the past few months, family-type smuggling crimes in coastal cities have been widely implicated. Many people in official circles and companies have been arrested one after another. Wen's father is even less convinced that he is involved in this large-scale economic case.
As soon as Wen's father was caught, the Wen family's enterprises that had been ousted by Fang Liucheng collapsed. He successfully took over the Wen family and made the Wen family heavily in debt, amounting to tens of millions. The Wen family's villa will be sealed and auctioned in a few days, and all the property in the Wen family's name will be confiscated.
Nuan Nuan became an accomplice invisibly. For so many years, she only cared about liking Fang Liucheng, but never thought about why he always asked her about her father's whereabouts and the details of his father's affairs...
Fang Liucheng walked into Wen's house and stood with his hands behind his back. He was wearing a white suit that highlighted his fit figure. His handsome facial features were strong and strong, giving people a somewhat cold and formidable feeling. As soon as the person stood at the door, he seemed to have the aura of giving orders. Warm and cold-hearted, it turns out that the gentleness and kindness over the years were all just an act. Mother Wen seemed to be going crazy and rushed to beat him. The bodyguards beside him pushed her aside. Nuan He and Wen Jing went up to help her.
Mother Wen pointed at his nose and scolded him for being ungrateful and repaying kindness with evil. Fang Liucheng smiled sarcastically. Wen Nuan kept his head down, then suddenly raised his head and asked, "Fang Liucheng, why?"
Fang Liucheng was startled by her title, and then smiled coldly, "Why, I also want to let you Wen family taste the feeling of family ruin."
More than ten yearsNot long ago, the Fang family was still a small construction company. Father Wen bought the Fang family, forcing the Fang family and his wife to hold hands and fall to their deaths, leaving young Fang Liucheng to live in an orphanage. Father Wen was patrolling around and learned that there was an orphan in the Fang family. He couldn't bear it and adopted Fang Liucheng. He almost grew up with Wen Nuan, and finally entered Father Wen's company, eventually destroying the Wen family.
At this time, Nuan Nuan realized that Fang Liucheng had long been successful and had his own business kingdom. He lurked in the Wen family just to defeat them.
Very good, perfect plan.
"Nuan Nuan, thank you so much." Fang Liucheng's voice was a little vicious, with a sense of revenge.
Wen Nuan straightened his back, showed a sweet smile, gritted his teeth, and said word by word: "Fangliucheng, the wind and water are changing, and you too will capsize one day, I'm waiting for you."
He seemed to see a dazzling brilliance in her.
